newsitem.title: UK: Amersham up again on Pharmacia tie-up glee.
newsitem.headline: Amersham up again on Pharmacia tie-up glee.

text.p: Shares in Amersham International Plc put on 58-1/2p to 1,541p on Wednesday as optimism continued over merging its life science operations with those of Pharmacia & Upjohn, analysts said.

"This is follow-through from yesterday. It was a little complicated to get (the deal) assimilated but analysts have thought about it overnight and there's also been positive press comment this morning," said one analyst.
"Amersham is tightly traded anyway and tends to make profound movements like this," he said.
Volume was a mere 70,126 shares by 0824 GMT.
Lehman analysts said in a research note, "Cost savings are expected to be 30 million stg by 1999/2000 with potential sales synergies in addition.
"This is far in excess of our guesstimate previously and completely changes our tentatively cautious view," the note said.
In share valuation terms Lehman said, "Even allowing for some slippage on growth and valuation Amersham appears to be cheap despite its recent rally."
